intent.raw_query: Thailand beaches, $1800 for couple, mix of island hopping and street food, October 2026

experiences.name: Phi Phi Islands Day Trip
experiences.description: Hop between the stunning Phi Phi islands by longtail boat, snorkeling in crystal-clear waters at Maya Bay, exploring Viking Cave, and relaxing on pristine white sand beaches made famous by 'The Beach'. Includes snorkeling gear and a traditional Thai lunch on board.

experiences.name: Bangkok Street Food Night Tour
experiences.description: Wander through the bustling lanes of Yaowarat (Chinatown) and Silom with a local guide, sampling iconic Thai street food including pad thai, mango sticky rice, grilled satay, tom yum soup, and fresh coconut ice cream from legendary street vendors and night market stalls.

experiences.name: Similan Islands Snorkeling Adventure
experiences.description: Take a speedboat to the world-renowned Similan Islands, a protected marine national park with some of Southeast Asia's best underwater visibility. Snorkel among vibrant coral reefs, sea turtles, and tropical fish. Includes park entry fee, equipment, and a beachside Thai lunch.

experiences.name: Koh Lanta Sunset Beach Kayaking
experiences.description: Paddle a sea kayak along the tranquil mangrove coastline and hidden sea caves of Koh Lanta, finishing at a secluded beach to watch a breathtaking Andaman Sea sunset. A peaceful and affordable way to experience Thailand's natural beauty away from the tourist crowds.

experiences.name: Chiang Mai Street Food & Night Bazaar Experience
experiences.description: Explore the legendary Saturday Walking Street and Night Bazaar in Chiang Mai's Old City, tasting northern Thai specialties like khao soi (coconut curry noodles), sai oua (herbed sausage), and crispy pork rinds while browsing handcrafted goods from hill tribe artisans in a vibrant cultural atmosphere.
experiences.location: Wualai Road & Night Bazaar, Chiang Mai Old City

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Thailand
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - arrival day
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled - arrival day
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Suvarnabhumi Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Clear immigration and customs, collect luggage, and arrange budget airport transfer (Airport Rail Link to city center or shared minivan ~200-300 THB). Check in to Aegean Bliss Resort. Grab a late-night snack from a nearby 7-Eleven or night street food stall near the hotel.

meals.breakfast: N/A - in transit
meals.lunch: N/A - in transit
meals.dinner: Late-night street food near hotel or 7-Eleven convenience store (pad kra pao rice box ~50-80 THB)

day_by_day.notes: Keep cash handy for transport and tips. Exchange currency at the airport (SuperRich or official booths offer better rates than hotel). Aim to get to bed early to recover from jet lag. Budget tip: Airport Rail Link costs ~45 THB vs ~600 THB for a taxi.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recover from jet lag. After a slow morning, explore the beachfront area around Aegean Bliss Resort. Take a leisurely walk along the beach, get oriented with the local area, and find a nearby local breakfast spot serving khao tom (rice porridge) or roti with condensed milk.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the local street market and town area near the resort. Visit a local fresh market (talat sod) to sample tropical fruits like mangosteen, rambutan, and dragon fruit. Pick up budget essentials like sunscreen, water, and snacks from local shops. Rent a bicycle (~100 THB/day) to explore the coastline.
day_by_day.evening: Head to the nearest beach night market or walking street for dinner. Try classic Thai street food dishes like pad thai, som tam, and grilled skewers. Watch the sunset from the beach with a cold Chang beer from a beach shack.

meals.breakfast: Local breakfast stall near hotel - khao tom or roti with egg (~60-80 THB)
meals.lunch: Fresh market fruit and snacks (~100 THB)
meals.dinner: Night market street food spread - pad thai, grilled pork skewers, mango sticky rice (~150-200 THB)

day_by_day.notes: October is the tail end of rainy season in some parts of Thailand - pack a light rain poncho. Stay hydrated and use sunscreen. Today is an orientation day so keep it relaxed. Budget for the day: ~500-600 THB total.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning visit to a nearby Buddhist temple (wat) for a peaceful cultural experience. Witness monks collecting alms (tak bat) if timing aligns around 6:30-7:00 AM. Dress respectfully with covered shoulders and knees. Explore the temple grounds and take photos.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the main local beach for swimming and sunbathing. Rent a snorkeling set (~150-200 THB) from a beach vendor and explore the shallow reef. Look for budget longtail boat tours to nearby viewpoints or hidden coves (~300-400 THB shared). Alternatively, explore tide pools and rocky outcrops along the shore.
day_by_day.evening: Find a local seafood restaurant away from the tourist strip for authentic and affordable grilled fish, steamed clams, and spicy seafood salads. Look for restaurants where locals eat - a good sign of quality and value.

meals.breakfast: Temple area street cart - sticky rice with grilled pork and iced coffee (~80 THB)
meals.lunch: Beach shack lunch - fried rice or noodle soup (~80-120 THB)
meals.dinner: Local seafood restaurant - grilled fish, tom yum soup, steamed rice (~200-250 THB)

day_by_day.notes: When visiting temples, remove shoes before entering. A small donation to the temple is appreciated. Budget tip: Eat where you see Thai families dining - food will be cheaper and more authentic. Daily budget estimate: ~700-800 THB.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day island hopping adventure! Join a budget group tour or arrange a shared longtail boat with other travelers (~600-900 THB per person for a full-day trip). Depart early morning to beat the crowds. Visit a first island known for clear waters and snorkeling spots.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue island hopping to a second and third island. Enjoy snorkeling over coral reefs, swimming in crystal-clear lagoons, and exploring hidden beaches. Pack your own lunch or buy from the boat tour (~150 THB extra) to save money. Look for starfish, tropical fish, and sea turtles.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon. Rest and freshen up. Head out for a relaxed dinner at a beachfront restaurant. Try massaman curry or green curry with jasmine rice. End the evening with a traditional Thai massage (~300-400 THB/hour) at a local massage shop.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at hotel or nearby stall before departure - toast with eggs and coffee (~80 THB)
meals.lunch: Packed lunch or boat tour lunch on the island (~100-150 THB)
meals.dinner: Beachfront local restaurant - curry with rice and fresh coconut water (~180-220 THB)

day_by_day.notes: Book island hopping tours the evening before to secure spots and negotiate group rates. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a dry bag for your phone, and plenty of water. Shared group tours are significantly cheaper than private charters. Budget estimate for the day: ~1,200-1,500 THB including tour.

day_by_day.morning: Morning kayaking rental along the coastline (~200-300 THB for 2 hours). Paddle through mangrove channels if available nearby, exploring sea caves and limestone karsts. Alternatively, join a budget guided kayaking tour for ~400-500 THB. Great for photography and nature spotting.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local fishing village to experience authentic Thai coastal life. Walk through the village, chat with friendly locals, and observe traditional fishing methods. Browse handmade crafts and local goods. Stop at a village eatery for a simple and delicious home-cooked lunch.
day_by_day.evening: Explore a local night market or food street. Try dishes you haven't eaten yet - look for boat noodles (kuay teow reua), larb moo (spicy pork salad), or khao man gai (poached chicken rice). Pick up fresh-squeezed fruit juices and Thai desserts like khanom krok (coconut pancakes).

meals.breakfast: Beachside café - banana pancake and iced tea (~100 THB)
meals.lunch: Fishing village local eatery - home-style Thai meal with rice (~80-100 THB)
meals.dinner: Night market food crawl - multiple small dishes and snacks (~200-250 THB)

day_by_day.notes: Respect fishing village communities by asking permission before photographing people. Kayaking is a great low-cost way to explore coastal areas independently. Budget estimate: ~700-900 THB.

day_by_day.morning: Take a budget ferry or speedboat to a nearby famous island for a day trip (~300-600 THB return depending on distance). Arrive early to enjoy the beaches before day-trippers arrive. Explore the main beach, rent a motorbike (~200-300 THB/day) to circle the island.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the island's most scenic viewpoint by hiking up a trail (usually free or ~20 THB entry). Enjoy panoramic views of the surrounding sea and islands. Cool down with a swim at a quieter beach on the far side of the island. Explore local shops and pick up budget souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Catch the last ferry back to the main island. Watch the sunset from the boat for a spectacular free experience. Have dinner at a local restaurant near the pier - fresh catch of the day is always a great choice at coastal areas.

meals.breakfast: Grab-and-go from 7-Eleven or hotel before ferry - coffee and sandwich (~60-80 THB)
meals.lunch: Island beachside shack - fried rice with seafood or papaya salad (~120-150 THB)
meals.dinner: Pier-side seafood restaurant - grilled prawns, stir-fried vegetables, steamed rice (~200-250 THB)

day_by_day.notes: Check ferry schedules the night before and book return tickets early. Last ferries can fill up. Motorbike rental requires a passport deposit - keep a copy handy. Wear helmets at all times. Budget estimate: ~1,000-1,300 THB including transport.

day_by_day.morning: Rest day and mid-trip laundry day. Find a local laundry service (~50-80 THB/kg wash and fold) near the hotel. While laundry is being done, explore a local fresh morning market (talat chao) for breakfast. Sample local Thai breakfast items like jok (rice porridge), patongo (Thai donuts), and fresh-squeezed orange juice.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax at the resort beach or hotel pool. Read a book, journal about your trip, or simply enjoy the beachfront. Alternatively, take a free self-guided walking tour of the local town - look for street art, old shophouses, Chinese shrines, and local life. Visit a local supermarket to stock up on snacks and water.
day_by_day.evening: Cooking class experience (optional budget splurge ~600-800 THB) at a local cooking school to learn to make pad thai, green curry, and mango sticky rice. If skipping the class, have a relaxed dinner at a local restaurant and try dishes you want to recreate at home.

meals.breakfast: Fresh morning market - jok with pork, patongo, and fresh juice (~80-100 THB)
meals.lunch: Supermarket or convenience store picnic on the beach (~100-150 THB)
meals.dinner: Cooking class dinner (if attending) or local restaurant - green curry, pad see ew (~200-250 THB)

day_by_day.notes: Mid-trip is a good time to reassess your budget and plan remaining days. Check if you need to book any transport or tours for the second half. Rest days are important on longer trips. Budget estimate: ~500-700 THB (excluding cooking class).

day_by_day.morning: Early morning beach yoga or meditation session on the beach (many resorts offer free or low-cost sessions ~100-200 THB). Watch the sunrise over the water. After yoga, explore a different section of the coastline you haven't visited yet. Look for local fishermen returning with their morning catch.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby national park or marine reserve for snorkeling or diving. Many areas have budget snorkeling day trips (~400-600 THB) that include equipment and boat transport. Alternatively, hire a longtail boat independently with other travelers for a custom island tour (~1,500-2,000 THB split between 4-6 people).
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cruise on a budget longtail boat (~300-400 THB per person for 1-2 hours) to watch the sky turn orange and pink over the ocean. Return to shore for a beach bonfire dinner at a local beach restaurant with live music.

meals.breakfast: Post-yoga smoothie bowl or açai bowl at a health café (~120-150 THB)
meals.lunch: Snorkeling tour packed lunch or beachside stall (~100-130 THB)
meals.dinner: Beach restaurant with live music - grilled seafood platter shared (~250-300 THB)

day_by_day.notes: National park entry fees are typically 200-500 THB for foreigners - budget accordingly. Early morning is best for calm seas and better snorkeling visibility. Budget estimate: ~900-1,200 THB.

day_by_day.morning: Street food breakfast crawl through the local town. Visit at least 3-4 different vendors to try a variety of Thai breakfast dishes. Look for vendors selling khao niao ping (grilled sticky rice), moo ping (grilled pork skewers), and cha yen (Thai iced tea). This is one of the best budget food experiences in Thailand.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local temple complex or cultural site in the region. Many temples are free or have a small donation box. Explore the grounds, learn about Thai Buddhism, and admire the intricate architecture. If there's a nearby viewpoint hill, hike up for panoramic views of the area (~1-2 hours round trip).
day_by_day.evening: Join a budget pub crawl or bar hop along the beach road to experience Thailand's famous nightlife without overspending. Set a drink budget and stick to it. Try local Thai whiskey (Ruang Khao or Blend 285) with soda and lime - very affordable compared to imported spirits.

meals.breakfast: Street food crawl - multiple small bites from 3-4 vendors (~150-200 THB total)
meals.lunch: Temple area food stall or nearby local restaurant - khao pad or noodle soup (~80-100 THB)
meals.dinner: Pre-nightlife dinner at a local restaurant - pad kra pao with egg on rice (~80-100 THB)

day_by_day.notes: Street food crawls are one of the best ways to experience Thai culture and cuisine on a budget. Keep small bills handy as most street vendors don't make change for large notes. Stay aware of your belongings at night. Budget estimate: ~600-800 THB.

day_by_day.morning: Take a day trip to a less-touristy neighboring island or beach. Research local recommendations from hotel staff for hidden gems that aren't in mainstream guidebooks. Rent a kayak or paddleboard (~300 THB/hour) to explore sea caves and rock formations independently.
day_by_day.afternoon: Beach afternoon with a focus on relaxation and free activities. Build sandcastles, collect shells, read, or simply swim. Look for free beach volleyball games with other travelers. Visit a beachside hammock café and enjoy a cold drink while swinging in the sea breeze.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a free Muay Thai boxing show if available in the area (many venues offer free shows to attract customers). Alternatively, find a beachside restaurant showing a live Muay Thai broadcast. Have a classic Thai dinner of tom kha gai (coconut chicken soup) and jasmine rice.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast if included, or local café - eggs and toast with coffee (~100-120 THB)
meals.lunch: Beachside coconut and fresh fruit from a beach vendor (~100 THB)
meals.dinner: Local Thai restaurant - tom kha gai, stir-fried morning glory, steamed rice (~180-220 THB)

day_by_day.notes: Ask hotel staff for insider tips on free or low-cost local experiences - they often know the best hidden spots. Free Muay Thai shows are common near tourist areas but check schedules in advance. Budget estimate: ~600-800 THB.

day_by_day.morning: Final major island hopping excursion. Book a full-day snorkeling and island tour to the most scenic islands in the region. Choose a reputable budget operator with good reviews. Bring your own snacks and water to save on tour extras. Aim to see at least 3-4 different islands.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the island tour. Spend extra time at your favorite island from the morning. Explore underwater marine life, relax on pristine beaches, and take plenty of photos. Look for opportunities to spot wildlife like monitor lizards, tropical birds, and reef sharks.
day_by_day.evening: Return from the tour and treat yourself to a slightly nicer dinner as a reward for the day's adventure. Find a restaurant with fresh seafood displayed on ice outside - pick your fish and have it grilled or steamed with garlic and chili. Pair with a cold Singha beer.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast before tour - rice porridge or toast (~80 THB)
meals.lunch: Tour provided or packed lunch on the island (~100-150 THB)
meals.dinner: Fresh seafood restaurant - whole grilled fish, seafood fried rice (~300-350 THB as a treat)

day_by_day.notes: This is one of your last full island hopping days - make the most of it! Take underwater photos if you have a waterproof case or rent a GoPro (~300-400 THB/day). Budget estimate: ~1,200-1,500 THB including tour.

day_by_day.morning: Souvenir shopping morning at local markets and shops. Buy budget-friendly Thai souvenirs like elephant pants (~100-150 THB), fridge magnets (~50 THB), handmade jewelry (~100-200 THB), and Thai spice sets (~100-200 THB). Practice bargaining politely - it's expected and part of the culture.
day_by_day.afternoon: Last beach afternoon at the resort's beachfront. Take a final swim, enjoy the view, and soak in the last moments of the Thai coastal experience. Get one last Thai massage (~300-400 THB for 1 hour) as a farewell treat. Pack your bags and organize your belongings for departure.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at your favorite restaurant from the trip. Order all your favorite Thai dishes one last time - pad thai, green curry, som tam, and mango sticky rice for dessert. Reflect on the journey and exchange contacts with fellow travelers you've met.

meals.breakfast: Familiar local breakfast spot - one last khao man gai or congee (~80-100 THB)
meals.lunch: Light beach lunch - fresh fruit, coconut, and spring rolls (~100-120 THB)
meals.dinner: Farewell feast at favorite restaurant - best dishes of the trip (~250-300 THB)

day_by_day.notes: Keep some Thai Baht for airport expenses and tips. Don't spend all your cash on souvenirs - keep at least 500-1,000 THB for transport and airport costs. Check hotel checkout time and arrange late checkout if needed for a small fee. Budget estimate: ~1,000-1,200 THB including souvenirs.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in Thailand. Wake up early for one last sunrise on the beach. Take a peaceful walk along the shoreline and say goodbye to the ocean. Enjoy a slow breakfast at a local café. Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort and store luggage if needed.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on flight time, explore any last spots you missed. Visit a nearby café for one final Thai iced coffee (cha yen). If time permits, visit a local temple for a quiet moment of reflection. Head to the airport or transport hub with plenty of time - allow 2-3 hours before departure for domestic connections or 3-4 hours for international flights.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Thailand with amazing memories of beaches, islands, and incredible street food. At the airport, use remaining Baht on food or last-minute souvenirs at duty-free. Board your flight home with a full heart and an empty wallet (in the best way possible).

meals.breakfast: Final Thai breakfast - pad kra pao and iced coffee at a local café (~100-120 THB)
meals.lunch: Airport food court - more affordable than airport restaurants (~150-200 THB)
meals.dinner: Airport or in-flight meal

day_by_day.notes: Budget tip: Airport food courts in Thailand are reasonably priced compared to other countries. Keep your boarding pass and passport easily accessible. Exchange any remaining Baht back to your home currency or save for your next trip to Thailand. Total trip budget estimate: 15,000-20,000 THB (~$400-550 USD) excluding flights and accommodation.

trip_options.title: Classic Thailand Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — late night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — late night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Suvarnabhumi Airport on Flight UA at 22:30. Clear immigration, collect luggage, and arrange private transfer or airport taxi to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, freshen up, and settle into your beachfront room.

meals.breakfast: Skip — in transit
meals.lunch: Skip — in transit
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night bite at the airport's food court (Try boat noodles or pad kra pao) or order room service at the resort upon arrival.

day_by_day.notes: Keep energy drinks or snacks handy for the journey. Pre-book your airport transfer in advance to avoid long taxi queues at night. Exchange some Thai Baht at the airport for immediate expenses.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and recover from jet lag. After a leisurely wake-up, take a slow morning walk along the beachfront near Aegean Bliss Resort. Explore the immediate shoreline, watch the sunrise if you're up early enough, and get a feel for the local beach vibe.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the nearest local market or beach town center for orientation. Visit any nearby temples or viewpoints within a short tuk-tuk or songthaew ride. Pick up any essentials (sunscreen, beach gear) from local shops.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll along the beach promenade at sunset. Explore the nearby street food night market — try grilled skewers, mango sticky rice, and fresh coconut water. Get an early night to reset your body clock.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast or a nearby café offering Thai-style breakfast — congee (jok), fried eggs with rice, and Thai iced tea (around 80–150 THB).
meals.lunch: Local beachside restaurant — order som tam (papaya salad), grilled fish, and steamed jasmine rice (150–250 THB).
meals.dinner: Night market street food crawl — pad thai from a street stall, fresh spring rolls, and mango sticky rice for dessert (200–350 THB total).

day_by_day.notes: Take it easy today — you just arrived. Stay hydrated as Thailand's humidity can be intense. October is the tail end of monsoon season in some regions, so pack a light rain jacket.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling or swimming at the beachfront near the resort. Rent snorkel gear from a local beach vendor (around 150–200 THB) and explore the shallow reef close to shore. Look for colorful fish and coral formations.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a half-day island hopping boat tour departing from the nearest pier. Visit 2–3 nearby smaller islands, snorkeling at coral spots, and relaxing on secluded beaches. Most group tours cost 800–1,500 THB per person.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the main beach area and enjoy a beachfront dinner as the sun sets over the water. Try fresh seafood grilled right on the beach.

meals.breakfast: Resort café or local bakery — banana pancakes, fresh fruit platter, and Thai coffee (100–180 THB).
meals.lunch: Packed lunch included with most island hopping tours, or grab food from a beach shack on one of the islands — grilled corn, fresh pineapple, and fried rice (150–250 THB).
meals.dinner: Beachfront seafood restaurant — grilled tiger prawns, steamed sea bass with lime and chili, and jasmine rice (350–600 THB per person).

day_by_day.notes: Book the island hopping tour the evening before through your resort or a local tour operator. Bring waterproof sunscreen, a dry bag for valuables, and reef-safe snorkel gear if possible.

day_by_day.morning: Rent a scooter or hire a local driver for a half-day exploration of the island's interior. Visit a local Buddhist temple (wat), observe monks during morning alms-giving if timed correctly, and explore lush jungle viewpoints.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local cooking class in the area — learn to make 3–4 classic Thai dishes including pad thai, green curry, and tom kha soup. Most classes run 3–4 hours and cost 1,000–1,500 THB including ingredients.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the fruits of your cooking class labor for dinner, or head to a lively local restaurant. Explore any nearby night markets and pick up handmade souvenirs.

meals.breakfast: Local street food stall — khanom krok (coconut rice pancakes), fried dough sticks with condensed milk, and fresh-squeezed orange juice (80–150 THB).
meals.lunch: Light lunch before cooking class — green mango salad and a bowl of tom yum soup at a local eatery (150–200 THB).
meals.dinner: Dishes prepared in your cooking class, or a mid-range Thai restaurant — massaman curry, stir-fried morning glory, and sticky rice (250–400 THB).

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly when visiting temples — cover shoulders and knees. Most cooking classes include a market tour to source fresh ingredients, which is a great cultural experience.

day_by_day.morning: Take a longtail boat to a nearby hidden beach or lagoon accessible only by water. Spend the morning swimming, sunbathing, and exploring sea caves or rock formations. Hire a private longtail for 1,500–2,500 THB for a half day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a relaxing afternoon. Enjoy the resort's pool, get a traditional Thai massage at a nearby spa (300–500 THB for 60 minutes), or simply lounge on the beach with a good book.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Thai cultural show or fire show on the beach if available locally. Many beach resorts and bars host evening fire performances around sunset.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — American or Thai set, fresh tropical fruit, and coffee (included or 150–250 THB).
meals.lunch: Pack snacks for the boat trip — fresh fruit, coconut water, and sandwiches from a local bakery (100–200 THB), or stop at a beach shack on the way back.
meals.dinner: Beachside bar-restaurant with live music — chicken satay, spicy basil stir fry, and a fresh fruit smoothie or local Singha beer (300–500 THB).

day_by_day.notes: Negotiate longtail boat prices before departure. Always confirm the route and stops with the boatman. Bring plenty of water and sun protection for open-water boat rides.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to a larger neighboring island via ferry or speedboat. Depart early to maximize time. Upon arrival, rent a scooter to explore the island's highlights — viewpoints, waterfalls, and local villages.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the island's most famous beach or snorkeling spot. Spend the afternoon swimming, kayaking (200–400 THB/hour rental), or paddleboarding in the crystal-clear waters.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the island's main town and its street food scene before taking the last ferry back. Stock up on local snacks and handicrafts.

meals.breakfast: Quick breakfast before the ferry — toast with local jam and Thai tea at a guesthouse café near the pier (80–150 THB).
meals.lunch: Beachside restaurant on the neighboring island — fresh fish tacos Thai-style, coconut soup, and a cold coconut (200–350 THB).
meals.dinner: Street food dinner at the island's night market before the return ferry — grilled squid, pad see ew, and fresh fruit skewers (200–350 THB).

day_by_day.notes: Check ferry schedules in advance and book return tickets early. Last ferries often depart around 17:00–18:00. Keep your resort's address card handy for the return journey.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recharge morning. Sleep in, enjoy a slow breakfast, and take a peaceful yoga session on the beach (many resorts offer complimentary or low-cost morning yoga at 07:00–08:00).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the local town's street food scene in depth. Join a guided street food walking tour (800–1,200 THB) or self-guide using a food map. Sample 8–10 different dishes across various stalls.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at a cliffside or rooftop bar overlooking the ocean. Watch the sky turn orange and pink over the Andaman Sea or Gulf of Thailand.

meals.breakfast: Resort or beachside café — acai bowl, fresh tropical fruit, granola, and a green smoothie (150–250 THB).
meals.lunch: Street food tour sampling — khao man gai (chicken rice), boat noodles, roti with banana and condensed milk, and fresh-pressed sugarcane juice (200–400 THB across multiple stalls).
meals.dinner: Upscale mid-range Thai restaurant for a sit-down dinner — red curry with duck, prawn pad thai, and sticky rice with mango for dessert (400–700 THB per person).

day_by_day.notes: Day 7 is a great day to do laundry, repack your bag, and plan the second half of the trip. Use the afternoon street food tour to discover hidden local gems for future meals.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning kayaking tour through mangrove forests or sea caves. Many operators offer guided 3-hour kayaking excursions through stunning limestone karst landscapes (800–1,200 THB per person).
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local fishing village accessible by boat or road. Observe traditional fishing practices, interact with local fishermen, and browse fresh catch at the village market.
day_by_day.evening: Beachfront bonfire or barbecue dinner if the resort offers it. Alternatively, join a group dinner at a popular local restaurant recommended by resort staff.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast before kayaking — rice porridge with ginger and egg, fresh juice, and Thai coffee (100–180 THB).
meals.lunch: Lunch at the fishing village — the freshest seafood you'll ever eat, simply grilled or steamed with local herbs (200–400 THB).
meals.dinner: Beachfront barbecue or local restaurant — mixed seafood platter, som tam, and sticky rice (350–600 THB per person).

day_by_day.notes: Mangrove kayaking is best done at high tide. Confirm tide times with your tour operator. Wear quick-dry clothing and water shoes for this activity.

day_by_day.morning: Take a full-day excursion to a national marine park or protected island group nearby (such as Similan Islands, Koh Lanta Marine Park, or Ang Thong National Marine Park depending on your base). Depart early by speedboat.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkeling at multiple sites within the marine park — spot sea turtles, reef sharks, and vibrant coral gardens. Hike to a viewpoint on one of the park islands for panoramic ocean views.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon/early evening. Wind down with a traditional Thai herbal steam bath or aromatherapy massage at a local spa.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast or grab-and-go from a local bakery — croissant, banana, and bottled water for the boat (150–200 THB).
meals.lunch: Boxed lunch provided by the tour operator on the boat, or food available at the park's designated eating area (included in tour or 150–250 THB).
meals.dinner: Relaxed dinner at the resort's restaurant or a nearby mid-range eatery — yellow curry with tofu, stir-fried vegetables, and jasmine tea (300–500 THB).

day_by_day.notes: Marine park full-day tours typically cost 2,500–4,000 THB per person including transport, snorkel gear, and a guide. Book 1–2 days in advance. Check seasonal park closures as some parks close during heavy monsoon months.

day_by_day.morning: Explore a local weekend or morning market (talad) for authentic Thai shopping. Browse fresh produce, local crafts, handmade jewelry, and traditional textiles. Great for picking up affordable souvenirs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby elephant sanctuary or wildlife conservation center for an ethical wildlife experience. Observe and feed rescued elephants in a responsible, no-riding environment (1,500–2,500 THB).
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate the mid-trip milestone with a special dinner at a highly-rated local restaurant. Dress up slightly and enjoy a multi-course Thai tasting menu.

meals.breakfast: Market breakfast — fresh-cut fruit, sticky rice with mango, and a warm bowl of boat noodles from market stalls (100–200 THB).
meals.lunch: Light lunch near the elephant sanctuary — vegetarian Thai dishes, fresh spring rolls, and coconut water (150–250 THB).
meals.dinner: Special dinner at a top-rated local restaurant — chef's tasting menu with 5–6 courses featuring regional Thai cuisine (600–1,000 THB per person).

day_by_day.notes: Always verify that elephant sanctuaries are ethical and do not offer riding or performances. Look for sanctuaries accredited by Elephant Nature Park or similar organizations. Morning markets usually wrap up by 10:00–11:00 AM.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise beach walk or early morning swim. Spend a peaceful morning on the beach before the crowds arrive. Collect shells, watch fishing boats head out, and enjoy the quiet beauty of the Thai coastline.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a half-day boat trip to a nearby sandbar or shallow lagoon for swimming and relaxing. Bring a picnic or purchase snacks from the pier. Alternatively, rent a kayak and explore the coastline independently.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a Thai street food cooking demonstration or join a local family for a home-cooked dinner experience (book through your resort or a local tour company, approximately 1,200–2,000 THB).

meals.breakfast: Beachside café — avocado toast with chili flakes, fresh papaya, and Thai iced coffee (150–250 THB).
meals.lunch: Picnic on the sandbar — fresh baguette sandwiches, tropical fruit, and coconut water packed from a local deli (150–250 THB).
meals.dinner: Home-cooked Thai dinner experience or street food cooking demo — multiple dishes prepared and eaten together in a communal style (included in experience cost or 250–400 THB for food separately).

day_by_day.notes: A home-cooked dinner with a local family is one of the most memorable cultural experiences in Thailand. Book through trusted platforms like Airbnb Experiences or local tour desks.

day_by_day.morning: Final island hopping adventure — revisit your favorite spots or explore a new set of islands you haven't visited yet. Spend the morning doing one last snorkeling session at the best reef you've found during the trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and begin packing. Take a final dip in the resort pool or ocean. Visit any local shops for last-minute souvenirs — Thai silk scarves, spice kits, artisan soaps, or local rum and spirits.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at your favorite restaurant discovered during the trip, or try a new upscale beachfront venue. Reflect on the journey over a beautiful final sunset dinner.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — full spread of Thai and Western options, fresh juice, and coffee (150–250 THB or included).
meals.lunch: Light lunch on the boat or at a beach café — fresh coconut, grilled corn, and a light noodle soup (150–250 THB).
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner — go all out with a fresh seafood platter, your favorite Thai curry, dessert, and a celebratory cocktail or mocktail (500–900 THB per person).

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your departure arrangements for the next day — taxi, transfer, or shuttle to the airport. Check ferry/flight schedules if you need to travel from an island back to the mainland. Reconfirm your return flight details.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning at leisure — wake up early for one last sunrise on the beach. Pack remaining items, check out of Aegean Bliss Resort, and store luggage with the concierge if your flight is later in the day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your flight time, spend remaining hours at a nearby café, beach, or local market. Visit any spots you may have missed during the trip. Head to the airport with ample time for check-in.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Thailand with incredible memories of beaches, islands, and street food adventures. Enjoy duty-free shopping at the airport and treat yourself to one final Thai meal before boarding.

meals.breakfast: Final Thai breakfast — khao tom (rice soup), fried eggs, and Thai tea at a local café near the resort (100–180 THB).
meals.lunch: Airport or town café lunch — green curry with rice or a fresh sandwich and smoothie (200–350 THB).
meals.dinner: Airport restaurant or lounge — one last bowl of pad thai or tom yum soup before your flight (250–450 THB).

day_by_day.notes: Arrive at the airport at least 2.5–3 hours before international departure. Declare any food items at customs. Keep some Thai Baht for last-minute airport purchases or convert remaining cash before departure. Safe travels!

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Thailand Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - late night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled - late night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Suvarnabhumi Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. A private luxury transfer will be waiting to whisk you to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, freshen up, and enjoy a welcome drink at the resort's beachfront lounge.

meals.breakfast: N/A - In-flight or airport dining
meals.lunch: N/A - In-flight or airport dining
meals.dinner: Late-night room service at Aegean Bliss Resort - indulge in a curated Thai welcome platter with jasmine rice, green curry, and tropical fruit

day_by_day.notes: Arrange private airport transfer in advance. Upon arrival, expect a traditional Thai welcome with garlands and cold towels. Keep the first night light — rest is a priority after a long flight.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a slow, luxurious start. Take a sunrise stroll along the private beachfront of Aegean Bliss Resort. Enjoy a full resort breakfast with panoramic ocean views, featuring fresh tropical fruits, dim sum, and made-to-order eggs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the nearby local beach town on a guided tuk-tuk tour. Discover hidden temples, colorful markets, and local artisan shops. Stop at a renowned viewpoint for sweeping coastal panoramas.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the resort's infinity pool bar, followed by a premium Thai fine dining experience at the resort's signature restaurant featuring a chef's tasting menu with wine pairings.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort - tropical fruits, pastries, Thai congee, and live cooking stations
meals.lunch: Beachside seafood lunch at a premium local restaurant - grilled tiger prawns, som tum, and fresh coconut water
meals.dinner: Chef's tasting menu at Aegean Bliss Resort's signature restaurant - 7-course Thai fusion with sommelier-selected wine pairings

day_by_day.notes: October marks the tail end of the wet season in some regions of Thailand — pack a light rain jacket. The resort concierge can arrange any same-day excursions or spa bookings.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the day with a private Thai cooking class at the resort or a nearby premium culinary studio. Learn to craft authentic dishes like pad thai, massaman curry, and mango sticky rice under the guidance of a master Thai chef.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to a vibrant local street food market for an immersive culinary exploration. Sample iconic Thai street snacks including satay skewers, crispy pork belly, roti with condensed milk, and fresh papaya salad. Guided food tour recommended.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a private beachfront dinner set up by the resort — tables on the sand, lantern lighting, personalized menu, and live acoustic Thai music.

meals.breakfast: In-class cooking breakfast - enjoy dishes you prepare during the morning cooking class
meals.lunch: Curated street food tour lunch - sample 8-10 iconic dishes across the local market with a private guide
meals.dinner: Private beachfront dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort - custom menu of Thai delicacies with champagne service

day_by_day.notes: Pre-book the private cooking class through the resort concierge. The street food tour is best experienced with a knowledgeable local guide who can navigate the best stalls and explain cultural context.

day_by_day.morning: Embark on a full-day island hopping adventure via a chartered private speedboat. First stop: a secluded limestone island with crystal-clear waters perfect for snorkeling among vibrant coral reefs and tropical fish.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue island hopping to a famous emerald lagoon island. Kayak through sea caves and hidden lagoons, then relax on a pristine white sand beach with a gourmet picnic lunch prepared by the resort.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by sunset. Wind down with a traditional Thai massage at the resort's luxury spa, followed by a casual yet refined dinner at the resort's oceanfront restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at the resort before departure - fresh fruit, yogurt parfait, and coffee
meals.lunch: Gourmet picnic on a private island - artisan sandwiches, fresh seafood, tropical fruits, and chilled rosé
meals.dinner: Oceanfront dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort - grilled whole fish, Thai herbs salad, and coconut ice cream

day_by_day.notes: Charter a private speedboat through the resort for maximum flexibility. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, snorkeling gear (or rent premium gear onboard), and a waterproof camera. October seas can be slightly choppy — confirm conditions with the captain.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a guided kayaking or paddleboarding session along the coastline near the resort. Explore hidden coves and mangrove forests accessible only by water. Return for a leisurely resort breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a nearby cultural landmark — a grand Buddhist temple complex. Dress respectfully and engage with a private guide who will explain the history, architecture, and spiritual significance of the site.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the local night market for authentic street food experiences. Try boat noodles, Thai crepes (khanom buang), grilled corn, and fresh sugarcane juice. End the evening with cocktails at a rooftop bar overlooking the coastline.

meals.breakfast: Post-activity resort breakfast - smoothie bowls, avocado toast, and Thai iced tea
meals.lunch: Premium Thai restaurant near the temple - traditional set lunch with tom kha gai, pad see ew, and fresh spring rolls
meals.dinner: Night market street food spread followed by signature cocktails at a luxury rooftop bar

day_by_day.notes: Temple visits require covered shoulders and knees — bring a sarong or lightweight cover-up. The night market is best visited after 18:00 when all stalls are fully open and buzzing with energy.

day_by_day.morning: Indulge in a full morning at the resort's luxury spa. Book a signature 2-hour treatment combining traditional Thai massage, herbal compress therapy, and aromatherapy. Follow with a dip in the resort's private pool.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a private longtail boat tour to explore local fishing villages and floating markets. Interact with local fishermen, observe traditional boat-building crafts, and sample freshly caught seafood.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset dinner cruise aboard a private catamaran. Sail along the coastline as the sun dips below the horizon, enjoying a premium seafood BBQ, champagne, and live music.

meals.breakfast: Light spa-friendly breakfast at the resort - fresh juices, granola, and seasonal fruits
meals.lunch: Fresh seafood lunch at a floating market or local harbor restaurant - steamed crab, grilled squid, and spicy seafood soup
meals.dinner: Sunset dinner cruise - premium seafood BBQ with lobster, prawns, and oysters paired with champagne and fine wines

day_by_day.notes: Book the spa treatments at least 24 hours in advance. The dinner cruise is a highlight — reserve early as spots are limited. Bring a light jacket for the evening sea breeze.

day_by_day.morning: Day trip to a famous nearby island known for its dramatic karst scenery. Depart early on a private speedboat. Hike to a panoramic viewpoint for breathtaking aerial views of the emerald bay below.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkel or free dive in the island's marine sanctuary. Explore vibrant coral gardens, sea turtles, and schools of tropical fish. Relax on the island's most secluded beach with personalized butler service.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a private rooftop dinner under the stars. The resort chef prepares a bespoke menu inspired by your culinary preferences, paired with premium Thai craft cocktails.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast box - croissants, fresh fruit, boiled eggs, and thermos coffee for the boat journey
meals.lunch: Island beach club lunch - fresh coconut, grilled seafood platter, and tropical cocktails
meals.dinner: Private rooftop dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort - bespoke tasting menu with Thai-inspired cocktail pairings

day_by_day.notes: Midweek island trips tend to be less crowded. Confirm snorkeling conditions with the boat captain. Wear water shoes as some island beaches have rocky shorelines.

day_by_day.morning: Join a private guided street food breakfast tour through the local town. Discover the best morning market stalls serving jok (Thai rice porridge), pa thong ko (fried dough), and traditional Thai coffee.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local elephant sanctuary for an ethical wildlife experience. Feed, bathe, and walk alongside rescued elephants in a lush jungle setting. No riding — purely observation and interaction.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and enjoy a relaxed evening. Dinner at the resort's beach grill — premium cuts, fresh catch of the day, and artisan cocktails by the fire.

meals.breakfast: Street food breakfast tour - jok, pa thong ko, fresh fruit smoothies, and Thai iced coffee
meals.lunch: Vegetarian Thai lunch at the elephant sanctuary - traditional dishes prepared by local staff
meals.dinner: Beach grill dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort - wagyu beef, grilled lobster tail, and seasonal vegetables

day_by_day.notes: Choose only ethical, AZA-accredited or reputable sanctuaries that do not offer elephant riding. Book in advance as slots are limited. Wear clothes you don't mind getting muddy during the elephant bathing experience.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga session on the beach led by a private instructor. Follow with a meditative walk along the shoreline, collecting shells and breathing in the fresh ocean air. Return for a health-focused resort breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore a nearby national park or nature reserve. Hike through lush jungle trails to hidden waterfalls. Swim in natural rock pools surrounded by tropical vegetation.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a traditional Thai cultural performance — classical dance, Muay Thai demonstration, or shadow puppet theater. Dine at a premium restaurant known for authentic royal Thai cuisine.

meals.breakfast: Health-focused resort breakfast - acai bowls, green smoothies, chia pudding, and herbal teas
meals.lunch: Jungle picnic at the waterfall - premium bento boxes prepared by the resort with Thai sandwiches, fruit, and sparkling water
meals.dinner: Royal Thai cuisine restaurant - multi-course traditional dinner with khao chae, miang kham, and massaman lamb

day_by_day.notes: Waterfall hikes can be slippery in October — wear proper hiking sandals or shoes. The cultural performance venue should be booked through the concierge. Royal Thai cuisine restaurants often require advance reservations.

day_by_day.morning: Chartered private yacht day begins. Board a luxury sailing yacht for an exclusive island-hopping expedition to three lesser-known islands. Enjoy the open deck with ocean breezes and a fully stocked bar.
day_by_day.afternoon: Anchor at a secluded bay for swimming, snorkeling, and sunbathing. The yacht's crew prepares a fresh seafood lunch onboard with Thai-spiced grilled fish, salads, and chilled wines.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the sunset from the yacht deck with champagne. Return to the marina and transfer back to the resort for a relaxing evening with in-room dining and a private jacuzzi session.

meals.breakfast: Pre-departure resort breakfast - eggs benedict, fresh pastries, and tropical juices
meals.lunch: Onboard yacht lunch - freshly grilled seafood, Thai salads, sushi rolls, and chilled wines
meals.dinner: In-room private dining at Aegean Bliss Resort - curated Thai comfort food menu with dessert platter

day_by_day.notes: Private yacht charters should be arranged 48-72 hours in advance through the resort or a reputable local charter company. Confirm crew qualifications and safety equipment. Bring extra sunscreen and a hat for the full day at sea.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely morning at the resort. Enjoy a floating breakfast in the private pool — a quintessential luxury Thai resort experience. Browse the resort's boutique for local artisan crafts and handmade souvenirs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a premium Thai spa village or wellness retreat for an afternoon of holistic treatments — herbal steam bath, traditional tok sen massage, and gold facial therapy.
day_by_day.evening: Exclusive street food dinner tour led by a local chef. Visit five carefully selected street food vendors for an elevated tasting journey through Thailand's most iconic dishes.

meals.breakfast: Floating pool breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort - tropical fruit platters, pastries, eggs, and fresh-pressed juices
meals.lunch: Light spa lunch at the wellness retreat - detox soups, raw salads, and herbal infusions
meals.dinner: Premium street food tour - pad thai, khao man gai, moo ping, oyster omelette, and mango sticky rice at five iconic vendors

day_by_day.notes: The floating breakfast is an iconic Instagram moment — arrange it the evening before with the resort team. The evening street food tour is best enjoyed on an empty stomach. Wear comfortable walking shoes.

day_by_day.morning: Final island adventure — take a private longtail boat to a secluded beach accessible only by sea. Spend the morning swimming, sunbathing, and exploring tide pools. Pack a luxury beach kit from the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for last-minute souvenir shopping and packing. Visit a nearby artisan market for hand-painted ceramics, silk scarves, and handcrafted jewelry. Enjoy a farewell Thai iced tea at a local café.
day_by_day.evening: Grand farewell dinner at the resort's most prestigious dining venue. The chef prepares a bespoke 9-course Thai gastronomic journey celebrating the flavors of Thailand, with a premium wine and cocktail pairing.

meals.breakfast: Packed luxury beach breakfast from the resort - sandwiches, fresh fruit, pastries, and cold brew coffee
meals.lunch: Casual beachside café lunch - tom yum soup, green papaya salad, and fresh coconut
meals.dinner: Grand farewell dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort - 9-course Thai gastronomic tasting menu with premium wine pairings and a personalized dessert

day_by_day.notes: Allow extra time in the afternoon for packing and settling any resort charges. Confirm departure transfer arrangements for the following morning. The farewell dinner is a special occasion — smart casual dress is recommended.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise walk on the beach — soak in the last moments of the Thai coastline. Enjoy a leisurely checkout breakfast at the resort with ocean views. Exchange contact details with resort staff and collect any pre-ordered takeaway gifts.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private luxury transfer to the airport. Arrive early to enjoy the premium airport lounge — spa treatments, fine dining, and shopping at duty-free. Reflect on 13 unforgettable days in Thailand.
day_by_day.evening: Departure. Carry the warmth of Thai hospitality, the flavors of street food, and the memories of pristine islands as you fly home.

meals.breakfast: Farewell resort breakfast - your choice from the full menu, savoring the last Thai breakfast experience
meals.lunch: Premium airport lounge dining - Thai and international selections with complimentary beverages
meals.dinner: In-flight dining or airport restaurant pre-departure

day_by_day.notes: Check out by 12:00 noon unless a late checkout has been arranged. The resort can store luggage if your flight departs later in the day. Ensure all souvenirs comply with customs regulations — particularly any food items or wooden crafts.
